authenticity_review: The image demonstrates high technical rendering quality: sharp focus, consistent studio lighting, vibrant colors, and no graphics-level distortions (perceptual_quality_auditor returned null distortion). However, significant semantic artifacts exist relative to biological realism: complete absence of fur texture, simplified anatomical structures, and toy-like proportions. While these features align with the 'plastic dogs' prompt intent, they represent catastrophic deviations from the German Shepherd taxonomy provided. The structural simplification (e.g., fused paws on orange dog) further reduces authenticity when evaluated against realistic standards.
key_defects: Count mismatch: Image shows 6 dogs instead of the requested 7.
Taxonomy failure: Objects lack all German Shepherd diagnostic features (noble head structure, sloping topline, bushy tail, double coat) due to stylized toy representation.
